rb = ep.robot()
print("gripper:", rb["gripper"])
print("links:", rb["links"] if not isinstance(rb["links"], dict) else list(rb["links"].keys()))
sp = np.array(rb["spheres"]); sl = rb["sphere_links"]
print("spheres shape", sp.shape, "n links", len(sl))
tcp = np.array(rb["tcp_pose"]); T = rh.pose_to_T(tcp)
Tinv = np.linalg.inv(T)
from collections import defaultdict
d = defaultdict(list)
for s, l in zip(sp, sl):
    c = s[:3]; r = s[3]
    cl = (Tinv @ np.r_[c,1])[:3]
    d[l].append((cl, r))
for l, lst in d.items():
    arr = np.array([np.r_[c, r] for c, r in lst])
    if np.min(arr[:,2]) > -0.25:   # near the tool
        print(l, len(lst), "tool-frame z range (approach axis)", arr[:,2].min().round(4), arr[:,2].max().round(4), "max z+r", (arr[:,2]+arr[:,3]).max().round(4), "x range", arr[:,0].min().round(3), arr[:,0].max().round(3), "y", arr[:,1].min().round(3), arr[:,1].max().round(3), "r", arr[:,3].min().round(3), arr[:,3].max().round(3))

vs, us = np.nonzero(red)

pts = []
for (u, v) in [(int(np.median(us)), int(np.median(vs))), (us.min()+4, vs.min()+4), (us.max()-4, vs.max()-4), (int(np.median(us)), vs.max()-3)]:
    p = ep.pick(cam, u, v)
    pts.append(p["point"])
    print("pick", (u, v), np.round(p["point"],4), "offset", p.get("offset_px"))
pts = np.array(pts)
